description: This file implements a negotiator for Git object revision exchange, managing commit marking, reference processing, and revision queue handling.

methods.name: rev_list_push
methods.description: Adds a commit to the revision list queue if not already marked, parsing it if necessary.

methods.name: clear_marks
methods.description: Clears specific flags from a commit object referenced by a ref.

methods.name: mark_common
methods.description: Marks a commit and its ancestors as common, optionally only ancestors, parsing commits if needed.

methods.name: get_rev
methods.description: Retrieves the next revision to send, ignoring common commits.

methods.name: known_common
methods.description: Marks a commit as known to be common and updates the revision list.

methods.name: add_tip
methods.description: Adds a commit tip to the negotiation process.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Gets the next revision to process.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the negotiator.

methods.name: default_negotiator_init
methods.description: Initializes the default negotiator with function pointers and state.
